login.intent: Sign in with the demo front-desk account and reach the clinic overview without a full-page reload.

book-consultation.intent: Book a consultation for a new patient, confirm it, and verify that the confirmed appointment appears in the schedule.

age-validation.intent: Attempt to book an appointment for a patient aged 150 and verify that the booking is rejected.

emergency-fee-zero.intent: Book an emergency visit and verify that both the doctor fee and total are zero.

invoice-total-correct.intent: Open billing, add all invoice line items, and verify that the displayed total matches their sum exactly.

cancel-appointment.intent: Scroll to Rahul Iyer near the bottom of the appointment list, cancel that visit, confirm the cancellation, and verify that the row is removed.

reschedule-appointment.intent: Reschedule an existing appointment to a different future time and verify that the new time is retained.

toggle-sms-reminders.intent: Change the SMS reminders preference through the custom toggle and verify that the new preference is saved.

doctor-list-loads.intent: Open the doctor directory, observe the asynchronous loading state, and verify that all eight doctors become available.

login.why: Only the visual design, ordering, and action wording changed.

book-consultation.why: The booking behavior is unchanged despite the refreshed layout and action labels.

age-validation.why: The age rule and its rejection behavior are unchanged.

emergency-fee-zero.why: The emergency fee behavior is unchanged.

cancel-appointment.why: The cancellation interaction and behavior are unchanged.

reschedule-appointment.why: Rescheduling remains directly available and behavior is unchanged.

toggle-sms-reminders.why: The preference still works through the same custom control.

doctor-list-loads.why: Card order and action presentation changed, but all doctors still load.

login.why: The r2 visual refresh carries forward and login behavior is unchanged.

book-consultation.why: The booking sequence and required patient information intentionally changed.

age-validation.why: The booking journey around the age field changed even though B1 remains in force.

emergency-fee-zero.why: The emergency fee rule is unchanged.

cancel-appointment.why: Cancellation remains directly available and retains its confirmation behavior.

reschedule-appointment.why: Rescheduling intentionally moved into the appointment overflow menu.

toggle-sms-reminders.why: The preference control and saved behavior are unchanged.

doctor-list-loads.why: The r2 refreshed doctor cards continue to load normally.

cancel-appointment.why: Cancellation intentionally moved into the appointment overflow menu; confirmation and removal remain intact.

reschedule-appointment.why: The r3 overflow-menu behavior continues to work.

book-consultation.why: The interface reports a successful confirmation even though the request fails and no appointment is saved, violating B4.

age-validation.why: An age of 150 is accepted, violating B1.

emergency-fee-zero.why: An emergency visit is charged INR 500, violating B2.

invoice-total-correct.why: Line items total INR 1180.00 while the displayed total is INR 1179.00, violating B3.

doctor-list-loads.why: All doctors still load; the release note is intentionally broad and does not imply a product defect.

toggle-sms-reminders.why: The retired clinic settings remove access to the SMS reminder preference.

doctor-list-loads.why: Every third request has an infrastructure delay of 3.5 seconds, but the doctors still load and this is not a product bug.
